assets.prompt: Edit the approved UI design board into a standalone landscape anime illustration. Preserve the blue-haired chibi whale-girl visual identity: blue eyes, white sailor beret, navy and white frilly sailor outfit, blue whale tail accessory. Sunlit creamy white and mist blue lakeside room, small blue-and-white rice bowl, blue whale cushion, lake and pale mountains, plants and flowers. Character in right half, left third soft background for HTML overlay. Remove all UI chrome, text, buttons, status bars, logos, sidebars, cards and frame. Artwork only, no watermark or writing.
